changes.quote: Maximum amount financed per customer $300,000 · Maximum mileage – Diesel: 120,000
changes.note: The record had the $250,000 per-transaction cap but not the $300,000 per-customer cap, which is the one that bites a repeat buyer. It also had no diesel mileage line at all — diesel runs 120,000 across every tier, where gas drops to 100,000 above 72 months. Also adds the 21-day lien perfection and 90-day title deadlines, and that TDAF does not refinance.

changes.quote: Two references with verifiable address and phone number
changes.note: Two references are a required credit-application field at TDAF and the record did not say so — a missing reference is a stip that holds the deal. Same for the two-year address history rule. Also adds that a POA must be approved before the decision, not after, and that trusts are ineligible outright.

changes.quote: Vehicles less than or equal to 1 year old that have not been registered, and have 8,000 miles or less, will be valued as new vehicles
changes.note: TDAF's new-vs-used line is 8,000 miles and one model year, which is looser than most of the book and was not recorded. It decides which value source applies.

ambiguities.note: td has been in acknowledged.json because the filename says 070126 while the record says June 30, 2026. The sheet's own footer reads 06/30/2026 on every page. The RECORD IS RIGHT and the filename is a day off. Same pattern as dfc. Renaming the Drive file to TD - Program Sheet - 063026.pdf and updating the SOURCES.md row would let this acknowledgement be deleted rather than carried.

The gas mileage tiers (120,000 for T1-6 to 72 months, 100,000 above 73 months, 100,000 for T7-8), the model-year term table, the BPS flat enhancement grid, the 80/20 split, the 6-payment chargeback protection, GAP at $1,500 with a 70% front-end LTV floor and the dealer self-funded warranty exclusion all match the sheet.
